outcome: DNA methylation of the fetal serotonin transporter gene (SLC6A4)
cohort: 50 mother-infant pairs, 18 mothers with GDM and 32 with NGT, all neonates were of normal birth weight and born at term by planned Cesarean section
finding: Average DNA methylation across the 7 analyzed loci was decreased in the GDM group compared to the NGT group and negatively correlated with maternal plasma glucose levels.
